basis: retail-equivalent annualized reference prices — the price an adherent would otherwise pay in the commercial market etzhayyim routes around (Charter §1.6 中間排除). Imputed value is expected to EXCEED internal provisioning cost (ADR-2605261000 §3) because retail prices carry margin + rent + intermediary capture that the actor mesh removes.
notes: DRAFT / 雛形. Every numeric value here is a placeholder planning figure pending (a) Council Lv6+ ≥3 attestation and (b) real per-adherent data from toritate imputed_income_compute + commons_asset_value cells. Do NOT treat as authoritative until status flips to 'attested' and councilAttestation lists ≥3 Lv6+ DIDs.

FLOW vs STOCK separation prevents double-counting: FLOW = consumption services actually consumed in the period (food, electricity, care, etc.); STOCK = annualized imputed value of SECURED ACCESS to capital/commons that is NOT a consumption service (security-of-tenure, productive-surplus access, substrate access). A dwelling appears in BOTH only as distinct facets: shelter-service consumed (FLOW) vs inalienable tenure security (STOCK).
All figures are per-adherent per-year USD unless marked otherwise.
Aggregate-only: these reference prices feed median/percentile computation; no per-adherent figure is ever published (ADR-2605301020 §7 + ADR-2605261000 N6).

v1.1.0-draft: sourceRef stubs populated with open, citable price sources (FAO / OECD / WHO / UNESCO / IEA / UITP). Figures themselves remain DRAFT pending Council Lv6+ >=3 attestation; status stays draft-pending-council-attestation until councilAttestation is non-empty.
valuationSources: Reference price sources MUST be open and citable (e.g. national CPI baskets, OECD household-consumption microdata, open retail price indices). Each category below carries a sourceRef stub to be filled at attestation.

flow._comment: Imputed income (FLOW). Market-equivalent annual value of in-kind services consumed per adherent.

food_staple.label: Minimum-food guarantee (≥4,500 kJ/day staple basket)
food_staple.sourceRef: FAO Food Price Index (FFPI) cereals sub-index, monthly — fao.org/worldfoodsituation/foodpricesindex (open)

otc_pharma.label: OTC drug access (yakushi Wave 1+1b+1c basket)
otc_pharma.sourceRef: WHO/HAI Medicine Prices database — OTC basket (open)

electricity.label: Electricity (≥3 kWh/day ≈ 1,095 kWh/yr)
electricity.sourceRef: IEA + Ember monthly electricity prices, residential kWh tariff (open)

shelter_service.label: Shelter service (≥10 m²/adherent dwelling-use on Land Trust)
shelter_service.sourceRef: OECD Affordable Housing Database HC1.2 (rent), 10 m^2 equivalent (open)

childcare.label: Childcare (≥40 hr/wk/child)
childcare.sourceRef: OECD Family Database PF3.4 — net childcare cost (open)

eldercare.label: Elder care (daily-living, non-medical)
eldercare.sourceRef: OECD Health Statistics — long-term (home) care unit cost (open)

education_basic.label: Literacy + numeracy + civics/charter education
education_basic.sourceRef: UNESCO UIS — adult literacy/numeracy public unit cost (open)

education_advanced.label: Advanced + vocational education (manabi R3)
education_advanced.sourceRef: OECD Education at a Glance — vocational expenditure per student (open)

mobility_commute.label: Inter-site commute substrate (wadachi Level-3)
mobility_commute.sourceRef: UITP / national transit authority published annual-pass fares (open)

healthcare.label: Health access (iyashi / mitate / yakushi)
healthcare.sourceRef: WHO Global Health Expenditure Database — out-of-pocket per capita (open)

stock._comment: Commons-asset access (STOCK). Annualized imputed value of SBT-bound NON-ALIENABLE access rights. NEVER title; never sellable / transferable / collateralizable / inheritable-as-title (ADR-2605301020 §2; ADR-2605192245 waqf generalization).

land_trust_tenure_access.label: Security-of-tenure value of inalienable Land Trust residency right (distinct from shelter_service consumption)
land_trust_tenure_access.sourceRef: OECD Affordable Housing Database HM1.3 (tenure security) — imputed rent-security premium (open)

actor_mesh_output_access.label: Access to actor-mesh productive surplus beyond subsistence (mitsuho / yakushi / hikari / etc. output)
actor_mesh_output_access.sourceRef: derived: imputed cooperative productive-surplus access (method in valuation/README; no single external feed)

data_substrate_access.label: kotoba content-addressed data + compute substrate access (Murakumo-resident)
data_substrate_access.sourceRef: published open object-storage/compute rate cards (e.g. S3 / Backblaze B2) — retail-equivalent (open)

energy_infra_access.label: hikari grid-edge capacity access beyond the 3 kWh/day consumption flow

stageBaskets._comment: Planning estimates of the per-adherent median imputed income (FLOW) + commons-asset access (STOCK) unlocked at each stage, and the resulting highIncomeBenchmarkRatio. Care categories are household-conditional, so the stage median uses a household-weighted estimate, NOT the per-child sticker price. DRAFT figures — superseded by real toritate metric data once cells are live.

benchmark.name: OECD upper-income-decile household consumption basket (per-adherent)
benchmark.note: Target ratio ≥1.0 at L6 is a TARGET, not a promise (ADR-2605301020 §3; N8 asymptotic — each generation re-validates). Benchmark itself is reviewed per Council generation cycle.
benchmark.sourceRef: OECD Income Distribution Database (IDD) + household-consumption microdata, top decile per-capita (open)

invariants.note: No row in this table is ever paid as cash. Every value is imputed (FLOW) or access-imputed (STOCK). cashStipendUsd ≡ 0 mirrors the metricReport structural invariant (ADR-2605261000 §5 N1).
